backend/main.mo: Defines core types, enums, and comparison logic for supermarkets, product categories, offers, and user profiles within the BuddyDeals backend actor.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Contains prewritten summaries of various frontend source files for documentation or tooling.
frontend/DEPLOYMENT_NOTES.md: Documentation‑only notes for re‑activating draft v70, including build checks and smoke‑test steps.
frontend/index.html: Base HTML template configuring PWA metadata, icons, splash screens, and loading the React entrypoint.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main React app setup with routing, authentication, conditional profile/setup flows, and layout structure.
frontend/src/components/FilterPanel.tsx: Mobile filter panel allowing supermarket and category selection with clear‑filter controls.
frontend/src/components/FilterSidebar.ts: Sidebar filter component supporting supermarket, category, and price‑range filtering with reset functionality.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Renders a footer with branding, a heart icon, and a link to the uitleg page.
frontend/src/components/Header.tsx: Implements the main header with navigation, authentication handling, notifications, admin tools, and cart indicators.
frontend/src/components/LocationPermissi: Modal prompting users for location access, handling geolocation requests and error states.
frontend/src/components/MeetingSupermark: Provides UI and logic to select a supermarket manually or via GPS, including distance calculation and nearest-store detection.
frontend/src/components/OfferCard.tsx: Displays a product offer card with image, supermarket badge, navigation, and add‑to‑cart functionality.
frontend/src/components/ProductSelection: Manages a multi‑step dialog workflow for selecting and confirming a meeting supermarket after choosing products.
frontend/src/components/ProfileModal.tsx: Renders a full user profile editing modal with fields, preferences, photo upload, and reviews. Loads user data via queries and handles saving, photo updates, and product selections.
frontend/src/components/ProfilePhotoUplo: Provides a photo upload widget with drag-and-drop, validation, previews, and conversion to ExternalBlob. Supports removing existing photos and reporting upload progress.
frontend/src/components/ProfileSetupModa: Initial profile setup flow collecting name, contact info, preferences, location-based supermarket suggestions, and optional photo. Saves new profiles and uploads photos using backend hooks.
frontend/src/components/ReviewModal.tsx: Modal for leaving a star rating and optional comment on another user tied to a shared payment. Submits the review via mutation and resets state on success.
frontend/src/components/SelectedProducts: Displays user-selected and shared products with counts, product details, and matching info. Allows inspecting shared items and visually summarizes current product selections.
frontend/src/components/SharedPaymentMod: Modal to create a shared payment invitation and start a Stripe checkout session for half-price shared offers.
frontend/src/components/ShareTestLinkBut: Button that opens a modal to share a fetched test link, allows copying and downloading a generated QR code.
frontend/src/components/StarRating.tsx: Displays a star rating with optional half stars and optional review count.
frontend/src/components/StripeSetupModal: Modal for entering and saving Stripe secret key configuration required for payments.
frontend/src/components/UserReviewsSecti: Shows average rating and a list of user reviews, or an empty state when none exist.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages a backend actor tied to the user's identity and refreshes dependent queries when it changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useAutoRetryOffers.ts: Automatically retries fetching offers with exponential backoff when none are returned.
frontend/src/hooks/useCart.ts: Zustand store managing cart items, quantities, totals, and persistence.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Defines a React context and provider for managing Internet Identity login, state, and stored identities using AuthClient.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Provides React Query hooks wrapping actor calls for user profiles, offers, images, and related mutations with toast notifications.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind CSS setup defining light/dark theme variables, supermarket‑styled backgrounds, animations, and utility classes.
frontend/src/lib/imageUtils.ts: Utility functions for product images including fallback handling, retry logic, preload checks, and standardized img props.
frontend/src/main.tsx: App entry point mounting React with QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider.
frontend/src/pages/CartPage.tsx: Renders the shopping cart UI with item management, price calculations, navigation, and product image handling.
frontend/src/pages/ExplanationPage.tsx: Renders an FAQ-style explanation page describing app workflows, especially supermarket selection and app features, using cards and accordions.
frontend/src/pages/FolderPage.tsx: Displays supermarket folder offers with images, pricing, navigation to offer details, and branding via logos and endpoint mappings.
frontend/src/pages/HomePage.tsx: Shows the main offers list, filters by user’s preferred supermarkets, and displays loading states and informational alerts.
frontend/src/pages/MatchPortalPage.tsx: Calculates and displays product match percentage between users, showing match status, product overview, and navigation controls.
frontend/src/pages/NotificationsPage.tsx: Lists user notifications, marks them as read, formats timestamps, and routes users to matched offer details when applicable.
frontend/src/pages/OfferDetailPage.tsx: Displays detailed information for a single offer, including images, supermarket branding, price formatting, and loading/error states.
frontend/src/pages/OffersPage.tsx: Shows the main offers list with search, filtering, tabs, auto-retry loading, and optional favorites integration.
frontend/src/pages/PaymentFailurePage.ts: Renders a failure message for unsuccessful payments with navigation options.
frontend/src/pages/PaymentSuccessPage.ts: Shows a payment success confirmation and invalidates shared payment queries before navigation options.
frontend/src/pages/SharedPurchasesPage.t: Lists shared payments, linking them to offers and enabling reviews, with status indicators and user-specific details.
frontend/src/pages/SupermarketSelectionP: Guides users through selecting a supermarket, using geolocation to find the nearest option and saving the choice to their profile.
frontend/src/pages/WeeklyFolderPage.tsx: Displays weekly folder offers per supermarket with carousel navigation, branding, and auto-retry fetching.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Configures Tailwind with custom OKLCH color palette, container settings, extended shadows, radii, and plugins for typography, animations, and container queries.
project_state.json: Defines project metadata, versions, and the single existing feature to rebuild and redeploy BuddyDeals draft version 70.
